metadata.title: Mid-Century Rock and Roll Band Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A 1950s-style studio band portrait featuring musicians in matching cyan tuxedos with black lapels against a pale green seamless background.
triggerTerms: vintage rock and roll album cover

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of five male musicians posed in a studio setting. They wear identical light cyan-blue jackets with wide black shawl lapels, white shirts, and black bow ties. The composition features a saxophonist on the left, two guitarists in the foreground and right, a drummer in the center-back, and a standing member in the rear. The lighting is flat and bright, typical of mid-century commercial photography, set against a pale, desaturated mint-green background.
coreVisualRelationships: Uniformity of attire creates a cohesive group identity
Staggered depth placement creates a sense of space in a flat studio
High contrast between black trousers/lapels and bright cyan jackets
Typography positioned at the top edge to frame the subjects
coreInvariants: Cyan jackets with black shawl lapels
Bold red sans-serif display type at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body group shot occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central guitarist and the saxophonist on the left provide the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bold red text at the top down to the bright cyan jackets, following the diagonal lines of the instruments.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space at the top for title text and around the figures to isolate them from the background.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, medium-saturation cyan against a low-saturation, high-value mint background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all primary display elements to maintain mid-century commercial simplicity.
graphicDevices: Small secondary metadata text in the top right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, sans-serif impact of the original.
Provides the appropriate mid-century grotesque feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of a five-piece 1950s rock band wearing matching cyan jackets with black shawl lapels and black bow ties. The band includes a saxophonist, two guitarists, and a drummer. They are posed against a solid, pale mint-green background with flat studio lighting. Leave the top 20% of the frame as empty background space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed, red sans-serif uppercase text across the top margin. Place smaller metadata text in the top right corner in a similar style but smaller scale.

verificationChecks: Are the jackets cyan with black lapels?
Is the background a pale mint green?
Is the text bold, red, and sans-serif?
Are the musicians holding period-accurate instruments?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original musicians
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cyan jackets have distinct black shawl lapels.
Check that the red text is perfectly horizontal and centered at the top.
Verify the background is a single, clean, desaturated color.
Confirm the instruments are visible and held in playing positions.
